name: tools-smw-enemy-name-editor
title: SMW Enemy Name Editor
description:
Tool to edit the enemy names shown during the end credits.
- Works both with headered/unheadered rom.
- Supports names longer than the original.
- Supports adding/removing names.
- Supports editing the character table to insert new characters.
(Table is created within executable folder when running the tool and it doesn't exists).

Tested with an unmodified copy with/without head.
